title: ST-GAT: A Leakage-Free Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Framework for Robust Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.19109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intrusion detection systems are a central defence in modern networks. Deep learning models report strong anomaly-detection results, but evaluations on standard benchmarks such as CSE-CIC-IDS-2018 are often inflated by two methodological problems: temporal leakage from overlapping sliding windows, and contamination from preprocessing fitted before the train/test split. Per-flow classifiers also ignore the spatio-temporal dependencies across sequences of network flows. We propose a Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention Network (ST-GAT) that represents traffic as a sequence of graph snapshots. It builds k-Nearest Neighbour (k-NN) edges within each window, applies multi-head Graph Attention Network (GAT) layers for spatial aggregation, and uses a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network with temporal attention for sequence modelling. translated_title: ST-GAT：一种无泄漏的时空图注意力框架，用于鲁棒的网络入侵检测
translated_abstract: 入侵检测系统是现代网络的核心防御手段。深度学习模型已展现出强大的异常检测性能，但在CSE-CIC-IDS-2018等标准基准上的评估结果往往因两个方法论问题而被夸大：一是重叠滑动窗口导致的时间泄漏，二是在训练/测试集划分之前进行预处理拟合所造成的污染。此外，基于单条网络流的分类器也忽略了网络流序列之间的时空依赖关系。我们提出了一种时空图注意力网络（ST-GAT），将网络流量表示为图快照序列。该模型在每个窗口内构建k近邻边，应用多头图注意力网络（GAT）层进行空间聚合，并使用带时间注意力机制的双向长短期记忆网络进行序列建模。为防止数据泄漏，我们采用非重叠的时间窗口（步长等于窗口长度），并拟合……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无数据泄漏的时空图注意力网络ST-GAT，通过将流量建模为图快照序列（k-NN图构建、多头GAT空间聚合、带时间注意力的BiLSTM序列建模），并采用非重叠时间窗口避免时间泄漏，从而实现鲁棒的网络入侵检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ST-GAT, a leakage-free spatio-temporal graph attention framework that models traffic as graph snapshot sequences—using k-NN edges, multi-head GAT for spatial aggregation, and temporal-attention BiLSTM for sequence modeling—with non-overlapping windows to prevent temporal leakage, enabling robust network intrusion detection.
